name: Wahoo Fitness
note: Atlanta, Georgia connected-fitness company (indoor trainers, bike computers); founded 2009 by Chip Hawkins. Rhône Group bought a majority stake in 2021; in 2023 the company was fully recapitalised and debt eliminated under Hawkins' leadership, with 'equal' new and existing investors including Rhône Group and David Wichmann (claim wahoo-hawkins-ownership).
